name: Испытательный центр
approval_context: Previous broad matrix/elements/applications references and same-style correction boards are invalid under the canonical atomic-only era reference contract and are not canonical visual evidence. E0 and E1 are now approved lineage evidence. The first E2 atomic machine spec is prepared, but no guarded E2 source has been accepted yet.

preserved: industrial serviceability and standardized safety language
physical electromechanical construction with readable maintenance access
replaced: E1 workshop-centric modules with denser rack-based test/diagnostic electronics
primarily hydraulic/electromotor emphasis with motorized servo and motor-reducer systems
mixed industrial surfaces with stronger beige/gray technical-plastic and aluminium laboratory language
basic organized trays with more explicit routed harnesses, connectors and diagnostic cabling
added: bulky CRT diagnostic hardware and deep housings
electronic racks, ventilation grilles and replaceable electronics modules
denser grouped early LED indication and test instrumentation
specialized diagnostic connectors and service interfaces
transition_from_e1.why: The base has matured from a standardized workshop into a dedicated aerospace test center where diagnostics, instrumentation and motorized control are first-class infrastructure.
transition_from_e1.player_signal: More electronics, deeper CRT hardware, dense routed cabling, diagnostic connectors and visibly motorized/servo components; E2 is technically busier than cleaner E3.

materials-construction/01-surfaces-stock.reason: Generated before the E2 machine spec and production_guard request/chat-bridge existed. Visually useful but process-invalid; archived as rejected provenance and forbidden as canonical visual evidence.

generation_checkpoint.next_step: Validate the new E2 materials-construction/01-surfaces-stock machine spec and generated prompt with production_guard, then generate exactly one new guarded source from the canonical request/chat bridge.

usage.reference_strategy: E0 and E1 are approved atomic lineage evidence. E2 remains BLOCKED as canonical visual evidence until every required E2 role is complete, exact-SHA reviewed and the E1↔E2 cross-era role-order gate passes. Previous broad reference boards, PR #45 correction boards and the archived pre-spec rejected attempt must not be used as canonical visual evidence.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; active screen data, glow, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
